name: Fentanyl

moa.t: Full μ-opioid agonist, about 100 times more potent than morphine, rapid onset, short duration after a single dose

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Fentanyl, IV infusion, 1 mcg/kg/hour (also becomes long acting after prolonged infusion due to fat solubility).
Fentanyl 0.25 mcg/kg, IV For painful procedures. Administer slowly to reduce risk 1–2 mcg/kg, IN of chest wall rigidity.

adjustments.t: Use when needed; neonatal respiratory depression near delivery

cautions.t: Accumulates with repeated doses or infusion

adverse_effects.t: Respiratory depression, bradycardia, chest-wall rigidity with rapid high doses, nausea, hypotension
